FINANCE COMMITTEE
                                     MINUTES

A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Tuesday, June 17, 2025, in Council Chambers
and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Pete Laybourn, Chainuan; Ken Esquibel; Mark Moody; and Scott
Roybal.


                                     AGENDA ITEMS

21.       RESOLUTION Directing the City of Cheyeime to list the Cheyenne Auxiliary Pumping
                        —




          Station located at 1504 Dillon Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming for sale to the public as
          specified. (SPONSORS DR. ALDRICH, MR. ESQUIBEL AND MR. MOODY)
                                -




Mr. Moody moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried with Mr. Esquibel and
Mr. Moody voting “YES” and Mr. Roybal voting “NO.”

Ward III Councilwoman Dr. Michelle Aldrich, and co-sponsor of the item, provided a brief history
and identified the challenges that exist with the renovation of the property. David Hopkinson,
Deputy City Attorney, provided additional information related to steps the City would take to
surplus the property. John Brodie, City Attorney, provided information related to options such as
leasing the property and placing conditions on the sale of the property. Chairman Layboum and
all committee members commented on the item. Public comments were made by Randy Byers,
TDSi the Design Studio, Inc.; Milward Simpson, Historic Preservation Board Chairman; Marian
Kalles and Stephanie Lowe, Historic Cheyenne Inc.

22.       LEASES/CONTRACTS/LEGAL:

          g)    Minimum Revenue Guaranteed Payment Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
                and the Cheyenne Regional Air Service Focus Team (CRAFT) for the fiscal year
                ending June 30, 2026. (2021 Specific Purpose Option Tax)

Mr. Roybal moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $253,572.00, seconded by Mr. Moody.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Brenda Moureaux, Deputy City Treasurer, provided a staff report and Wendy Volk, CRAFT
Chairwoman, provided additional information including a brief history of the program. Committee
members Moody and Roybal commented on the item.

          h)    Industrial and Economic Development Services Agreement between the City of
                Cheyenne and the Cheyenne/Laramie County Corporation for Economic
                Development (LEADS) for the period of July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026. (General
                Fund)
